root_cause.text: The uncore discovery table parsing lacked a bounds check on the die index, allowing out-of-range die numbers (when dies are offline or missing) to be used as an array index into `pmu->boxes`, leading to an array overflow.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `(die >= uncore_max_dies())` check to skip invalid die indices, and the commit message explicitly states that "This can lead to an array overflow at 'pmu->boxes[die] = box' in uncore_pci_pmu_register()".
